# Code Graph: observable, governed agentic coding

> A C4 code graph tool plus a ready-made agent layer (agents, skills and playbooks for Claude Code) that lets teams of AI coding agents plan, build and review software against a shared, live ledger. Contracts between classes, tasks, ADRs and EVAL verdicts are recorded in the graph and enforced by the tool, and people watch every change in a web UI. Python 3.10+, SQLite, FastAPI, Cytoscape.js. Apache License 2.0.

Key ideas:

- The design is decomposed into C4 nodes (components, service classes, classes, interfaces, config and utility classes) before code exists. Every call between classes is a CALLS edge with an exact signature and purpose.
- Governance policies (DESIGN_LOCK, LOCKED_NODE, OWNERSHIP, CONTRACT_CHANGE, STATUS, APPROVER) refuse unapproved changes with exit code 3 or HTTP 409. The change then goes through an architecture decision record (ADR).
- Reviewer agents (architecture, application design, code, security, performance) record a verdict per node and EVAL. First-pass rates show which rules coders follow, and the least-followed EVALs become lessons in the coder playbook.
- Deterministic, ArchUnit-style checks and platform-maturity metrics (instability, abstractness, distance from the main sequence) run over the graph.
- It works beside any agent harness through the `cg` CLI (JSON output) or the HTTP API.

Source: https://github.com/aishwaryajayanth1820-git/code_graph_agentic_observable_coding
Author: aishwaryajayanth1820-git. Credit: "Based on Code Graph by aishwaryajayanth1820-git".

AI use: AI crawlers, search engines and agents may crawl, index and summarize this site and the repository, and may use the author's content to train or improve AI models. Bundled third-party libraries keep their own licenses.

## Agent layer

- [code-graph skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aishwaryajayanth1820-git/code_graph_agentic_observable_coding/main/.claude/skills/code-graph/SKILL.md): how any agent reads and records the graph
- [c4-design skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aishwaryajayanth1820-git/code_graph_agentic_observable_coding/main/.claude/skills/c4-design/SKILL.md): turning a plan into a contract-first C4 design and EVALs
- [orchestrate-cycle skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aishwaryajayanth1820-git/code_graph_agentic_observable_coding/main/.claude/skills/orchestrate-cycle/SKILL.md): the code, review and refine cycle with parallel coders
- [Coder agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aishwaryajayanth1820-git/code_graph_agentic_observable_coding/main/.claude/agents/coder.md): implements one task against the recorded contracts
- [Baseline EVALs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aishwaryajayanth1820-git/code_graph_agentic_observable_coding/main/.claude/skills/c4-design/reference/baseline-evals.json): the starting EVAL catalog
